column1: # start_table.md §2.1 (revision 2): the DISPOSITION of every member of
# call_graph.py's derived start family (and of its seeds). One line per
# definition; inventory_check.py fails if the call graph names a member this
# file does not, or this file names one the graph does not. Classes:
#   TABLE   a first-match row array the refactor folds into cand_rows[]
#   WALK    a selection over a table; becomes cand_select(slot, route)
#   PRED    a row's predicate (or its helper), kept by pointer
#   EMIT    a row's payload hook or emission body, kept byte-stable
#   INLINE  a function holding an inline start decision that becomes a row
#   READER  reads another slot's SELECTION (a slot-graph edge, §1.3) or hands
#   PROJ    renders a selection as a stamp, rx_info field or listing line
#   ROUTE   decides which route (and so which (slot, route) pairs) applies
#   BODY    a search-body writer: the skeleton (§1.3) that asks the slots
#   LANDMARK a landmark derivation; a pick INSIDE a row, not a row (§2.5)
#   TYPE    [r2.1 C-N1] a ROW TYPE (a family table's element type, or a type it
#           embeds by value): its fields become CandRow's (§1.1)
#   PLAN    orchestration only: names a member, decides nothing about a start
#   NOTSTART reaches a landmark only to answer a non-start question (machine
#           form, match-here axis, MRL storage): stays outside, reason given
